full_judgment: 4. The defendant Nos.1/2(ka)-2(Chha) and 3-5 contested the suit by filing’ a joint writ-ten statement contending that one Majeruddin Lal was owner in possession of the suit land and after his death before the cadastral survey, the suit land was recorded in the names of his three sons, namely, Mohiruddin, Makaruddin and Mosiruddin. Makantddin subsequently died without any issue and his share devolved on his two brothers Mohiruddin and Masiruddin. Accordingly, Mosiruddin and Masiruddin became owners in possession to the extent of 8 annas share each. The heirs and legal representative of Mohiruddin instituted Other Suit No. 05 of 1988 against the predecessor-in-interest of the plaintiffs for partition claiming saham of 13 kranti land. Summons of the suit was duly served upon the predecessor-in-interest of the plaintiffs, the defendant No. 18 and after his death, on substitution plaintiffs become party defendant in the suit but they did not contest the suit. The suit was accordingly decreed exparte on 24.9.1992 and the final decree was passed on 31.5.1994. The predecessor-in-interest of the present defendant never transferred or settled any land to the predecessor of the plaintiffs. The plaintiffs had no title or possession in any land of the aforesaid Other Suit No. 5 of 1988.
